name: 15-banquet-rows
prompt: Long rows of identical banquet tables with white cloths in a huge, half-empty, cold hotel ballroom, harsh overhead lighting, a lonely, impersonal corporate dinner atmosphere. Cinematic, luxury, high-end corporate film. Deep black and charcoal palette, with subtle hot pink (#FF1FA9) and warm gold-yellow (#FCD500) neon rim light and soft neon glow rings. Shallow depth of field, anamorphic lens flares, rich shadows, filmic grain. No on-screen text, no logos, no watermarks.
